## Services
- [New Home Framing](https://benra-framing.netlify.app/services/new-home-framing.html): From the first floor deck to the last roof truss, we frame new homes, laneway houses and infill builds square, plumb and ready for inspection â€” on schedule.
- [Renovation & Addition Framing](https://benra-framing.netlify.app/services/renovation-addition-framing.html): Tying new framing into an existing home is its own skill â€” matching floor heights, removing load-bearing walls safely, and keeping the rest of the house standing while we work.
- [Deck Framing & Construction](https://benra-framing.netlify.app/services/deck-framing.html): A deck is only as good as what's underneath it.
- [Fence Framing & Installation](https://benra-framing.netlify.app/services/fence-framing.html): A fence that stays straight starts with posts set deep and level.
- [Basement & Suite Framing](https://benra-framing.netlify.app/services/basement-suite-framing.html): A legal secondary suite has to meet fire-separation, egress and ceiling-height rules that a casual basement reno often misses.
- [Structural Framing Repair](https://benra-framing.netlify.app/services/structural-framing-repair.html): Sagging floors, bouncy joists, a header that's cracked or a beam that's settled â€” we diagnose the real cause and repair the framing properly, not just hide the symptom.
- [Rot & Water Damage Repair](https://benra-framing.netlify.app/services/rot-water-damage-repair.html): Wet coastal winters are hard on wood.
- [Garage, Shop & Shed Framing](https://benra-framing.netlify.app/services/garage-shed-framing.html): Whether it's a two-car garage, a home workshop or a backyard shed, we frame outbuildings that are properly anchored, correctly sized, and built to last through Lower Mainland winters.
- [Rough Carpentry & Blocking](https://benra-framing.netlify.app/services/rough-carpentry-blocking.html): The blocking and backing you never see is what keeps a mounted TV, a grab bar or a heavy cabinet secure for years.
- [Commercial Tenant Improvement Framing](https://benra-framing.netlify.app/services/commercial-tenant-improvement-framing.html): Retail, office and restaurant build-outs run on tight timelines.
- [Multi-Family & Townhome Framing](https://benra-framing.netlify.app/services/multi-family-framing.html): Townhome and low-rise multi-family projects need a crew that can frame the same unit accurately, over and over, on a schedule set months in advance.
- [Post & Beam / Timber Framing](https://benra-framing.netlify.app/services/post-beam-timber-framing.html): Exposed post-and-beam and heavy timber structures are as much craft as engineering.
- [Engineered Lumber Installation](https://benra-framing.netlify.app/services/engineered-lumber-installation.html): Engineered lumber carries real, calculated loads â€” which means it has to be installed, hung and (when necessary) modified exactly to the manufacturer's and engineer's specifications.
- [Insurance & Storm Damage Framing Repair](https://benra-framing.netlify.app/services/insurance-storm-damage-framing.html): A fallen tree, wind-damaged roof or burst-pipe flooding needs framing repair done right and documented clearly â€” so your insurance claim and your rebuild both go smoothly.
